name: Amashiro Takiyasu
source:
A scientist who worked with [url=/c154435]Kozue Benika[/url]. 

[Spoiler]He's the father of [url=/c102769]Amashiro Sumera[/url] and [url=/DBthingy]Amashiro Tagui[/url]. 

He was drugged and manipulated to conduct unethical experiments on his children. 

Died by Amashiro Sumera's hand, when she tried to kill [url=/c154435]Kozue Benika[/url].[/spoiler]
